Method of Attack: Predatory loan schemes via Android and iOS apps
Misleading loan terms with hidden fees and shortened repayment periods
Stealing excessive sensitive data from mobile devices (contacts, SMS, photos, media)
Uploading stolen data to attacker-controlled servers
Harassment and extortion of borrowers using stolen data
Use of risky permissions to access sensitive device information
Attack Vector: Mobile loan apps installed from Google Play and Apple App Store
Indicators of Compromise: Loan apps requesting risky permissions (contact list, SMS content, photos, media)
KYC forms requesting government ID photographs
Deceptive loan terms with interest rates up to one-third of borrowed amount
Shortened repayment periods from promised 180 days to 8 days
Harassment messages sent to contacts using stolen images and data
